title: I spent months building a game where you don't get to play. It's about pigs. One of them just died to a fart.
author: oytaub
selftext:
So here is my turn ! Thanks to the one who created this sub, here is my own contribution, well Claude code and i.

Some honesty up front, because you'll notice anyway.

The graphics are bad. The pigs look like someone described a pig over the phone. I know. They're too busy fighting to care.

**The game**

PigWars is an auto-battler. You build a pig, send it to war, and then have no control over it whatsoever. I removed the part of the game where you play the game. This was on purpose.

What I managed to put in instead:

\- **90 personas** that emerge from your stats. The best-written one is The Dead Weight: "Does literally nothing. May accidentally block a hit by standing in the wrong place at the right time." It's the easiest to get. You just don't spend any points.

\- **Pigs that think for themselves**, which mostly means they think of leaving. A smart pig runs away when it's losing. A stupid one never does. Neither listens to you.

\- **Teamwork**, sort of. They call for help, focus fire and regroup. They also charm each other onto the wrong side and walk into lava. The lava works. It's one of the few things I'm confident about.

\- **Permadeath.** The pig you spent a week on can die in forty seconds, and it stays dead. There's a screen called the Ancestry that lists every pig you've lost. It fills up fast. I built a whole screen for your failures and it's one of the more polished ones.

\- **Titles**, earned in battle. I hoped for Last Pig Standing. Most of mine end up as The Coward or Punching Bag.

**Things I'm not, and what I did about it**

\- **I'm not a map designer.** So there's a map editor, and the community can do it instead. I'm told this is called "user-generated content". I call it delegating.

\- **I'm not a fashion designer either.** Same solution: you can dress the pigs yourself. Apparently that's trendy. The pigs have no opinion. One of them wears a cowboy hat into lava.

\- **I'm not an artist, a composer or a fast programmer.** See below.

The trailer is one real, unstaged battle. I picked a hero. He was mind-controlled by the enemy on tick 3 and later killed by his own teammate's fart. I didn't script that. I couldn't have. I don't control them either.

**Where the AI is**

\- **Code**: written with Claude Code. It's better at this than I am, which is a sentence I've made my peace with.

\- **Audio**: there are no sound files for effects or music. Everything comes out of oscillators at startup, because I couldn't afford a composer and didn't want to ask one. The pigs' voices are TTS pitched up until it stops sounding like a man with a cold.

\- **Art**: \[fill in: pig model, skins, props\]. Whatever you're about to say about it, I've said worse.

No LLM runs during a battle. The pigs are dumb in the old-fashioned, hand-tuned way.

**If you still want to**

It runs in the browser at https://pigwars.app, and it's on Google Play ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oytaub.pigwars ) . It's early. It will get better. Probably.

Tell me which pig you built and how it died. They all die.

One more thing: big up to Ozzy. "War Pigs" was taken, and frankly oversaturated, so it's PigWars.
